business_summary: Victory Securities (Holdings) Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated financial services in Hong Kong. It provides securities/futures/insurance policies broking, placing, and underwriting services; securities advising, financing, asset management, and financial advisory services; and investment and insurance consultancy services. The company also offers virtual asset dealing services; securities brokerage services with respect to virtual asset-related exchange traded funds; and virtual asset advisory services, as well as markets and distributes virtual asset-related private funds. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Victory Securities (Holdings) Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Dr. TT Kou's Family Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: Victory Securities (Holdings) Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 홍콩에서 통합 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권/선물/보험 증권 중개, 배치 및 인수 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권 자문, 금융, 자산 관리 및 금융 자문 서비스; 투자 및 보험 컨설팅 서비스. 회사는 또한 가상 자산 거래 서비스도 제공합니다. 가상자산 관련 상장지수펀드에 관한 증권중개업; 및 가상자산 자문 서비스를 제공하며, 가상자산 관련 사모펀드의 판매 및 유통을 담당하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 2016년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 셩완에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Victory Securities (Holdings) Company Limited는 Dr. TT Kou's Family Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
